fr_html: M. ADATCI dit qu'à première vue, ce projet lui semble bon. Avant de se prononcer, il veut cependant avoir le temps de réfléchir.
en_html: M. ADATCI said that at first sight the project seemed to him to be a good one. Before definitely committing himself, however, he wished to have time to think it over.
